text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
Well, I suppose that's enough for today?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading to the lab now.
Trainer, please prepare for tomorrow's experiment—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Ayabe-kun.
Are you heading to training now?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...You can tell just by looking, right?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Trainer-kun! As for me, I've decided
to keep training just like this!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: With Ayabe-kun, of course!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? I have no intention
of training with you, though.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, don't worry about it.
I'm just running alongside you of my own accord!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
“...... You're a Trainer, right?
Could you please stop Tachyon-san?”
choice_data_list: I'll let Tachyon do as she pleases.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Wh...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's fine.
Because I have my own will!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What about my opinion?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "I really wanted to see Ayabe-kun run up close just once!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Hey, are you even listening to me!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now, no need to hold back!
Run with all your might!
Agnes Tachyon stuck closely by Admire Vega's side as she tried to shake her off, dedicating herself to... "training" for a while.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What, do you really think you have the right to—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That's a relief. Well then.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...Did it get away? And here I thought
I'd get to observe it closely."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
This is your fault, Trainer-kun!
Take responsibility, take responsibility!

Despite Agnes Tachyon's grumbling,
we wrapped up today's training without issue.
